<details><summary>What the change connects to (4 closed, 0 open)</summary>

Questions the reviewer answered about what this change does to the running product. The engine checked that the cited lines exist, not that the answers are true.

**Closed, with the lines they rest on**

- Ready card 'Show in Finder' and 'Drag to …' buttons in the Library grid (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/components/ready-copy-card.tsx:80`) — The file is revealed or dragged out. The card, the chip and the outline stay afterwards. If it fails: `void revealLocalRecording(...)` ignores a rejection and nothing is shown, the same as the toast and use-local-library. The card is only rendered when `video.id !== null`. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/components/ready-copy-card.tsx:74-100`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.tsx:277-299`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/hooks/use-local-library.ts:97-99`.
- Retire Ready-to-upload cards when the route leaves /library (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:99-103`) — A later Library visit opens on the plain grid, with the copy's own card tagged and outlined. A copy finished while away gets a card on the next visit. In list view, or when filters hide the copy, the card is never shown but is still retired on leaving. If it fails: None found. The state is in memory only, so a relaunch starts with nothing. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:92-106`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/ready-copies.ts:97-100`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library/library-page.tsx:126-133`.
- Read a copy's destination back from the sidecar fingerprint (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/copy-destination.ts:13-17`) — Grid tags and the Copies panel show the destination for older files. If it fails: A missing fingerprint returns null, so the copy shows its kind badge or title. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-presets.ts:177-188`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-reuse.ts:18`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/destinations.ts:98-103`.
- Export widget minimized state in sessionStorage (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-widget-state.ts:10-35`) — Minimize holds for later exports. An error always shows in full, and Retry returns to the pill if it was minimized. If it fails: An unreadable storage reads as expanded, which is harmless. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-widget-state.ts:1-51`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.tsx:34-55`.

</details>

<details><summary>What the reviewer checked</summary>

**Batch 1 of 2.** I found no blockers in this part, only three smaller points; each is tied to a line in the diff, and I only read the code, as instructed.

- **Ready card actions:** Show in Finder and the native drag on the Library ready card don't call `markCopySeen`. The toast's equivalents do, and `ready-copies.ts` still says acting on a ready card marks the copy seen.
- **Weak test:** the library-page test "opening the copy goes to its page and forgets it" only checks the pathname, so it would pass without the forgetting.
- **Accessibility:** the minimized pill's `aria-label` replaces its text, and the nested `progressbar` is not exposed to a screen reader. The percent is lost to assistive tech.

I also checked these and found nothing wrong:

- The fingerprint fix (`copyPresetOf` compares only the part before `#`) matches `encodeFingerprint`.
- Retiring cards through the sidebar's route watch holds up across router Back and in-memory state.
- The `backgroundCopy` message keys used here exist in `en.json`.

The PR body's "Email wording" bullet isn't implemented in this head. `DESTINATION_IDS` has no email and the messages have no email variants, so email copies would use the "other" wording. I couldn't tell whether that belongs to a different branch of the stack.

**Batch 2 of 2.** I found nothing to flag in this part (CSS, docs, i18n messages). I only read the files, so none of this was run or rendered.

- **Design tokens:** the CSS variables the new stylesheets use are defined in `packages/tokens/css/tokens.css` or `base.css`. `--bg-hover` is not defined anywhere, but `ready-copy-card.module.css` gives it a fallback.
- **Tag colours:** the destination tag colours match `destination-logo.module.css`.
- **i18n keys:** `en.json` and `es.json` carry the same keys. The removed `hide` and `readyDragToUpload` keys have no remaining callers.
- **Message selects:** the ICU `select` messages all have an `other` branch, so the `"export"` and `"other"` arguments the callers pass are handled.
- **Docs:** the backlog doc's claims match the code I checked. `progressHidden` and `hideExportProgress` are gone. `retireReadyCards` is called from `sidebar.tsx`. `copyDestinationOf` is used in `library-page.tsx`.
- **Layout:** the Library grid is `repeat(3, 1fr)`, so `grid-column: span 2` fits.

I did not read `export-widget-state.ts` or the runner changes, which belong to part 1, so I recorded no contracts for the minimize action.
